name: fr-personal-income-tax
description: French personal income tax (impôt sur le revenu, IR) for a household resident in France: the income of 2025, declared and taxed in 2026, under the 2026 scale set by the 2026 finance law (0%, 11%, 30%, 41%, 45%; bands EUR 11,600, 29,579, 84,577, 181,917 per share). Covers the family quotient and its caps, the décote, category allowances, deductions, reductions and credits, the CEHR and the CDHR 20% minimum rate, withholding at source (rates, default grid, modulation), the flat tax on investment income (30% or 31.4%, depending on the income and collection date), filing deadlines by département, and penalties. Trigger on "impôt sur le revenu", "barème 2026", "quotient familial", "décote", "CEHR", "CDHR", "prélèvement à la source", "taux PAS", "déclaration 2042", "flat tax 31,4", "TMI". Out of scope: self-employed results in depth (fr-income-tax), social contributions (fr-social-contributions), gains on securities (fr-capital-gains), rental income (fr-rental-income), crypto (fr-crypto-tax)
